anomalies.observed: Pin 48 and pin 73 of the STM32H753 (both named VCAP, a power_out regulator-decoupling pin) are the only MCU connections on the UART3 nets. UART3_TX_FCC joins FCC1 pin 48 (VCAP) to UART3_FCC1 pin 3, and UART3_RX_FCC joins FCC1 pin 73 (VCAP) to UART3_FCC1 pin 4. No UART-capable pin of the MCU is on these nets.
anomalies.expected: UART3 TX/RX must connect to USART-capable GPIO pins (alternate function), not to the internal core-regulator VCAP pins, which need a dedicated 2.2 µF capacitor to ground and must not drive or receive signals.
anomalies.impact: The UART3 link to the FCC cannot work, and the VCAP regulator output is loaded or shorted by external signal lines, which can disturb core-supply regulation.

anomalies.observed: NAVC1 VSS pins 18 and 63 form a private net (Net-(NAVC1-VSS-Pad18)) that is not on GND, and VSSA pin 12 is an isolated net. The FCC1 ground pins, by contrast, are all on GND.
anomalies.expected: All VSS and VSSA pins of the STM32F405 should return to the board ground (GND).
anomalies.impact: The navigation MCU's ground return is incomplete, so its supply and I/O references are floating or degraded and it may malfunction or fail to power up properly.

anomalies.observed: PCA9685 address pin A0 (pin 1) is tied to the +3.3V net, while A1 to A5 are on GND. This sets the device address to 0x41 rather than 0x40.
anomalies.expected: The specification lists the PWM driver PCA9685PW at I2C address 0x40, which requires A0 to be tied to GND.

evidence.quote: PWM/servo driver | FCCPeripherals | NXP PCA9685PW (I2C 16-ch PWM), I2C addr 0x40

anomalies.impact: If the address is 0x41 the firmware expecting 0x40 will not communicate with the servo driver. The INA219 also uses 0x40 on the same FCC I2C2 bus, so the strap choice needs to be confirmed.
